title: Small Steps Beside the Marsh
paras: Tuesday, 8 a.m. Mist covered the marsh when our walking group reached an [[enormous|enormous]] old tree. I was keeping field notes for a series of gentle nature walks. Beside me, Hana, a [[gymnastics|gymnastics]] coach recovering from a leg injury, remained [[silent|silent]] while she watched two ducks feeding among the brown leaves.

Our [[arrangement|arrangement]] was simple: walk for ten minutes, then rest and record what we noticed. Anyone who found the walk unsuitable could leave early and receive a full [[refund|refund]]. Our guide, Luis, had the [[power|power]] to change the route if the ground became unsafe. After checking a muddy slope, he chose the flat path beside the water.

At our first stop, I [[lay|laid]] a waterproof sheet on a dry patch of grass. Hana showed us a breathing [[technique|technique]]: breathe in gently, then breathe out slowly while relaxing the shoulders. We stayed seated as a small bird searched the mud. I noted its yellow legs and the tiny rings spreading across the water.

By the return journey, Hana was pointing out birds herself. Luis offered a [[compliment|compliment]] on her sharp eye. She laughed and said she had forgotten to hurry. That evening, I recorded these observations for our nature [[podcast|podcast]]. My final note was brief: today, a short distance had given us plenty to notice.
zh: 星期二，早上八点。我们的步行小组走到一棵巨大的老树旁时，薄雾笼罩着沼泽。我正在为一系列轻松的自然漫步活动做实地笔记。在我身边，正在从腿伤中恢复的体操教练哈娜一直没有说话，只是看着两只鸭子在褐色落叶间觅食。
我们的安排很简单：步行十分钟，然后休息，记录观察到的事物。任何觉得这次步行不适合自己的人，都可以提前离开并获得全额退款。如果地面变得不安全，向导路易斯有权改变路线。他查看了一处泥泞的斜坡后，选择了水边平坦的小路。
第一次停下来时，我在一块干燥的草地上铺了一张防水垫。哈娜教给我们一种呼吸方法：轻轻吸气，然后慢慢呼气，同时放松肩膀。我们坐着，看一只小鸟在泥地里寻找食物。我记下了它黄色的腿，以及水面上扩散开来的细小波纹。
返程时，哈娜已经开始主动指给我们看鸟了。路易斯称赞她观察敏锐。她笑着说，自己已经忘了赶路。那天晚上，我把这些观察录成音频，用于我们的自然播客节目。最后一条笔记很简短：今天，短短的一段路让我们留意到了许多事物。

q.s: Hana talked while watching the ducks when the group reached the tree.
q.why: 她看鸭子时一直没有说话。

q.s: One member of the group asked for a refund during the walk.
q.why: 文章只说明退款规定，未说有人申请。

q.s: Luis praised Hana for her ability to notice birds.
q.why: 哈娜指出鸟的位置后，路易斯称赞她眼尖。
